figures.name: Eklingji

ability.name: Mewar's Lord
ability.description: All Rajput allies gain +3 to all stats from divine sovereign protection.

figures.description: The Shiva deity of Mewar whose blessing the Rajput Rana sought before every battle.

figures.name: Prithviraj Chauhan

ability.name: Chauhan's Arrow
ability.description: Deal 8 damage to one target from sound alone; this attack is guided by voice.

figures.description: The last Rajput king of Delhi whose legendary archery skill allowed him to hit a target by sound alone.

figures.name: Padmavati

ability.name: Johar's Flame
ability.description: When this card is destroyed, deal 5 fire damage to all enemies from the fire of honor.

figures.description: The legendary Chittor queen of supreme beauty whose sacrifice by fire (Johar) became the symbol of Rajput honor.

figures.name: Rana Sanga

ability.name: 18 Wounds
ability.description: This card ignores all debuffs from wounds and fights at full power regardless of HP.

figures.description: The great Mewar king who bore 18 wounds in battle and rallied all Rajputs in a final stand against Babur.

figures.name: Maharana Pratap

ability.name: Chetak's Charge
ability.description: Deal 7 damage to the most powerful enemy; cannot be captured or controlled.

figures.description: The Mewar king who never surrendered to the Mughal Empire and whose divine horse Chetak died saving him.

figures.name: Chetak

ability.name: Dying Leap
ability.description: When destroyed, this card first leaps over one enemy dealing 5 damage — the final gift of loyalty.

figures.description: Maharana Pratap's blue-grey horse who carried him to safety with a broken leg before dying from his wounds.

figures.name: Mirabai

ability.name: Bhakti's Poison
ability.description: Immune to poison and all worldly harm; grant +4 magic to all devotee allies.

figures.description: The Rajput princess who abandoned royalty for Krishna devotion and whose bhakti poetry became immortal.

figures.name: Tejaji

ability.name: Snake Oath
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to one enemy; this card cannot be broken by any oath-breaking ability.

figures.description: The Rajput folk hero who died keeping an oath to protect cattle and was deified as a healer of snakebite.

figures.name: Roop Kanwar

ability.name: Sati's Will
ability.description: When this card chooses to fall, all allies gain +4 power from sacrificial strength.

figures.description: The most recent figure in Rajput Sati tradition whose story remains deeply controversial in modern India.

figures.name: Gogaji

ability.name: Goga's Lance
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to all snake and dark enemies; grant +2 to all Rajput warrior allies.

figures.description: The warrior-saint Goga Maharaj who is worshipped at snake shrines and protects against snakebite.

figures.name: Pabuji

ability.name: Desert Honor
ability.description: This card cannot retreat; it deals +2 bonus damage while any ally is at risk.

figures.description: The Rajput folk hero and camel deity of the Thar desert whose epic is still sung by Bhopa singer-priests.

figures.name: Dhola Maru

ability.name: Desert Journey
ability.description: Move any ally to any position; grant +2 speed to all mounted allies.

figures.description: The legendary Rajput couple whose camel ride across the desert has become an icon of eternal love.

figures.name: Hari Raya

ability.name: Solar Blood
ability.description: All solar-lineage (Suryavanshi) allies gain +2 to all stats for 1 turn.

figures.description: The sun in his divine kingly form from whom the Suryavanshi Rajput clans trace their divine ancestry.

figures.name: Soma Raya

ability.name: Lunar Blood
ability.description: All lunar-lineage (Chandravanshi) allies gain +2 to all stats for 1 turn.

figures.description: The moon in his kingly divine form from whom the Chandravanshi Rajput clans trace their lineage.

figures.name: Ramdev Baba

ability.name: Sacred Miracle
ability.description: Remove all disease and curse effects from one ally; grant +1 to all stats.

figures.description: The Rajput saint revered by Hindus and Muslims alike who performed miracles of healing at Ramdevra.

figures.name: Jasol Mata

ability.name: Village Shield
ability.description: All common and uncommon allies gain +1 defense from the village goddess's protection.

figures.description: The protective village goddess of Marwar who guards the community and punishes those who harm her devotees.

figures.name: Bhomiya Ji

ability.name: Field Boundary
ability.description: Prevent all enemy flanking and position-switch abilities for 1 turn.

figures.description: The guardian spirit of Rajasthani field boundaries who protects the land and its farmers.

figures.name: Battle Drum

ability.name: War Beat
ability.description: All warrior allies gain +2 power at the start of the next turn.

figures.description: The spirit of the great Rajput war drum whose thunder announced battle and galvanized warriors to glory.

figures.name: Sati Mata

ability.name: Honor's Fire
ability.description: When any ally falls, all remaining allies gain +1 power from the sacred fire of sacrifice.

figures.description: The deified spirit of Rajput women who chose death with their husbands rather than dishonor.

figures.name: Rao Jodha

ability.name: Jodhpur's Fort
ability.description: While in play, all ally defense cannot be reduced below 4.

figures.description: The founder of Jodhpur whose massive Mehrangarh Fort became a symbol of Rajput invincibility.
